answer: At 22 units per epoch, sustaining 399 aliases for 36 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the adversary. The fee is charged through a glacier debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the canyon totals, and the timber anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. Each active identity forfeits a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. That is 15 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
